figurative_meaning_en: state of carelessness or being off guard
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে হাঁ মুখ করে রাস্তা পার হচ্ছে, বিপদ হতে পারে।
কাজ করার সময় হাঁ মুখ করো না, মনোযোগ দাও।
example_sentences_in_english: He is crossing the road with an open mouth; it could be dangerous.
Don't be careless at work, stay focused.
note: This idiom evokes imagery of someone so inattentive that their mouth is literally or figuratively open, common in Bengali folklore for describing naivety.
